Simultaneous 2 player patch for **R.C. Pro-Am (USA) (Rev 1)** on the NES.

**Download:** `rcproam_2p.ips` (below, under Assets)

Apply it to `R.C. Pro-Am (USA) (Rev 1).nes` (CRC32 `0296E5F4`) with any IPS tool
(Flips, Lunar IPS, or an online patcher). The patched ROM has CRC32 `BA00BA0C`.

On the title screen press **SELECT** (or **START** on controller 2) to choose
**FOR 2 PLAYERS**. Player 2 drives the green car, and the screen follows whoever
is in the lead. See the README for the full rules.

1-player games are unchanged.
